verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Asana's developer API, app components, MCP server, and general community sentiment comparing Asana to Jira/Planner, but contains no documentation of sprint-specific features (sprint boards, backlogs, velocity, iteration planning) that would demonstrate agile sprint planning support. Missing for 10: any documentation of sprint boards, backlog management, story points/velocity tracking, or sprint-specific templates within Asana.
